Represents timing information for game loops and frame updates.

Remarks

GameTime provides timing data for both variable and fixed timestep game loops. It tracks total elapsed time since application start, frame counts, and time between frames. This struct is immutable and provides various time unit conversions for game timing needs.

Fps

Gets the current frames per second (FPS) based on the elapsed time between frames.

public int Fps { get; }

Property Value

int

The current frames per second as an integer value. Returns 0 if no time has elapsed between frames.

Remarks

This property calculates FPS by taking the inverse of the elapsed seconds. If elapsed time is zero or negative, it returns 0 to avoid division by zero.
